hypotheses.title: Ethopropazine Extends Lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster
hypotheses.claim: Chronic administration of ethopropazine extends lifespan in Drosophila melanogaster. Treated flies will live longer than untreated controls under identical conditions.
hypotheses.rationale: Ethopropazine modulates neurotransmitter signaling and may reduce excitotoxic stress. Such modulation can lower cellular damage accumulation and thereby slow aging in flies.
hypotheses.prediction: Supplemented fly cohorts will show a statistically significant increase in median and maximum lifespan relative to controls.
hypotheses.experiment: Raise matched cohorts on food with and without ethopropazine under identical conditions and record age at death. Compare survival curves with log-rank analysis.
